Title: Not Every Wisdom Tooth Needs to Come Out - Check This Before You Decide

Description:
Dentists used to pull wisdom teeth out as a precaution, but current guidance says that's not automatic - it comes down to two signs. A gum flap trapping food and bacteria causes pericoronitis (throbbing pain, bad breath, swollen gums), and a tooth coming in tilted can wear down the root of the molar next to it. Either one points toward removal, easiest in your early twenties. No infection and a clean bite? Regular checkups are enough.
